summary: Production dependency resolved from a mutable GitHub branch
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On every `npm install`, npm clones whatever the default branch of that repository currently holds and runs any lifecycle scripts it contains on the installer's machine. The source is off-registry and unpinned, so the installed code can change at any time without any change to this package's published version, and is not covered by the npm registry's immutability guarantees or any scanning performed against the registry. The `ping`/HTTP GET hits in lib/Utils/generics.js are ordinary presence/connectivity primitives in the library's own code and are not the basis of this finding.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
